The trip card sits in the sheet below a 340-560 px hero (moto_detail_view_v2.dart:117,122-134) and DetailMoreV2 (description, parameters, prices; :154), while REZERVOVAT is the sticky MgDock always on screen (:176-185), enabled whenever a start exists and !busy (moto_detail_page.dart:275). The hard block in the booking form (bookingValidationErrorProvider) is outside this chunk and was not re-verified here. Server: no licence check on new-booking INSERT found (unknown/no).
